Corollary
[Reduced distance based at the singular time for a Type A solution] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0162, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0163 ↗ thm:chow-iv-singular-time-reduced-distance-limit 1. ch30:30.11\group Singular-Time Reduced Distance

For a complete Type A singular solution on $[0,T)$, every $p\in \mathcal M$ and sequence $T_i earrow T$ admit a subsequence for which $\ell _{p,T_i}$ converges locally in $C^ eta $, $0< eta <1$, to a locally Lipschitz reduced distance $\ell _{p,T}$. It satisfies \[ -\partial _t\ell _{p,T}-\Delta \ell _{p,T}+| abla \ell _{p,T}|^2-R + rac{n}{2(T-t)}\geq 0 \] in the support and weak senses.
